note: Judgement file. Source: the independent Gate 1 audit (review/gate-1/audit/, commit 7bf03a9: 0 BLOCKER, 15 MAJOR, 5 MINOR) plus what could not be verified in this environment. 'fixed' = repaired AND covered by a test or check that fails without the repair. Edit by hand after each audit; tools/verify-map.mjs reads open BLOCKERs from here.

defects.title: The level played itself (bot took 0 damage; a passive runner finished in ~1 minute)
defects.how: Hunting/waking/alerting AI, body collision, faster enemies, third (ranged) enemy, viability gates. tests/shipped.test.js 'viability' + tools/verify-map.mjs: the runner dies or is blocked, the perfect bot takes 24/54/80 damage on easy/normal/hard.

defects.title: Opening radio calls collided with the title card and overwrote each other
defects.how: Pure FIFO CommsQueue (tests/story.test.js) + a real-walk browser check (no teleport) that sees pier-start first, then pier-tower; radio blip plays when a message is shown.

defects.title: Review images did not show what a player sees; bundle mixed builds; README typed AGENT_VERIFIED and 'no defects'
defects.how: shoot tools clear overlays and use reachable cameras; gate1-bundle reads status from validation/campaign.json, defects from this file, and reports evidence provenance per commit.

defects.title: A Gaunt was embedded in a lamppost
defects.how: Moved; validateMap now rejects any body spawned inside a solid prop or another body (tests/ai.test.js).

defects.title: Enemy AI was sight-only and nothing collided with the player
defects.how: Hunt-to-last-known-position with a patience timeout, wake on damage/noise/alerts, sight-blocking cover, actor collision, pillar-safe steering (tests/ai.test.js).

defects.title: Load-then-Retry restored the wrong inventory
defects.how: World remembers levelStart (save v6, migration from v5); Retry uses it, also after a load (tests/ai.test.js).

defects.title: Title screen said 'engine skeleton build'
defects.how: Title text corrected.

defects.title: No onboarding: no Use prompt, no control hints
defects.how: Door prompt ('[E] open' / 'Locked: needs the brass key'; secrets never advertise themselves), controls legend on title/pause and for the first seconds of a fresh run. Browser-checked; not yet judged by a human first-time player.

defects.title: Pause menu overflowed the viewport
defects.how: Scrollable panel, settings/controls collapsed by default; browser check at 1280x720, 1280x600, 800x600, 1024x480.

defects.title: The spaces still read as one kit on a flat grid
defects.how: Slate customs shed, per-room light colours, off-lattice bollards, denser plaza cover, more props.
defects.remaining: There are still only two wall skins and one interior floor; every floor is y=0. Level layout variety beyond this is Gate 2 work (the production kit), and is the main creative risk to judge in the screenshots.

defects.title: ADS pose: yellow sleeves and a slab covered the lower frame
defects.how: Sleeves fade out in the sights, gun slightly smaller when aiming.
defects.remaining: The receiver's rear face is still visible under the sight line (it is an iron-sight view).

defects.title: Real-GPU performance is unmeasured
defects.how: Frame times are now recorded unclamped, the budget is compared with a recorded baseline (x1.25) at asleep AND all-awake vantage points.
defects.remaining: All measurements are headless Chrome on software GL. Nothing here says 60 FPS on a real machine. Needs a run on real hardware.

defects.title: Evidence pipeline could not record a failure
defects.how: verify-map: viability gates, blockers read from this file, generated notes, browser evidence bound to the map sha, canonical-route sha; validate marks evidence stale when the route file changes.

defects.title: Pointer lock has never been exercised in a real browser session
defects.how: A refusal right after Esc no longer latches drag-to-look (two refused CLICKS are needed); a click-to-capture hint shows.
defects.remaining: Headless Chrome cannot grant pointer lock; the Esc -> Resume -> click flow must be hand-tested in real Chrome.

defects.title: Default Fire included Left Ctrl (W+Ctrl closes the tab)
defects.how: Second Fire slot is now F; Ctrl is not a default anywhere (tests/bindings.test.js).

defects.title: Dead-end menu flows
defects.how: Load buttons hidden when there is no quick save; F5/F9 quick save/load; honest end-of-preview text; Enter/Space ignored for 0.5 s after a screen appears.

defects.title: Wheel spinning weapons, resume ignoring rebinding, unused Weapon 3
defects.how: Wheel accumulation + cooldown; any Pause-bound key resumes; weapon3 removed.

defects.title: Brittle startup and deployment
defects.how: Loading and error screens, WebGL/context-loss handling (browser-checked with WebGL disabled), base './', event log capped and dev-only, tooling moved to devDependencies.

defects.title: The secret had no tell and a wasted reward
defects.how: A faint hairline of lamplight at the panel seam, a hint in the pilot's log, and two armour vests (useful at any health) instead of a health kit.
defects.remaining: Discoverability by a real player is untested.

defects.title: Score scheduler could dump a burst of bells after a stall
defects.how: Schedule clamped to the audio clock (tests/audio.test.js fails without it).

defects.title: Balance and feel have never been played by a human
defects.remaining: The bot has perfect aim and never misjudges. Enemy speeds, damage, the Bellhand toll-shot readability, ammo and health flow were tuned with bots and unit tests only.

defects.title: Audio has never been heard by a person
defects.remaining: 31 effects and 2 score renders exist as WAV files for listening (review/audio/); mix-level loudness and music-versus-effects balance are not measured (audio QA renders each effect in isolation).

defects.title: Par time (5:00) is a placeholder
defects.remaining: It is 2x-8x the bot's time by a test; no human run has informed it.

defects.title: Only one level exists
defects.remaining: Nothing here proves 68 maps of this quality are achievable; that is precisely what Gate 2 would test.
